name: Parallel Sort-Last Image Compositing for Volumes
aliases: Sort-last Volume Rendering with Associative Compositing
Sort-last volume rendering on PC clusters
definition: A parallel rendering approach extending sort-last image compositing (used for opaque surfaces via IceT) to translucent volumes by leveraging the associativity of the Porter-Duff 'over' operator.
summary: Parallel Sort-Last Image Compositing for Volumes renders large distributed translucent volumes by partitioning data, rendering local sub-images, and combining them via associative alpha blending to avoid complex data movement.
